title: Sidecars that let decoding start halfway through an entropy-coded slice

definition.title: Sidecars that let decoding start halfway through an entropy-coded slice
definition.source_excerpt: Prepare source-bound arithmetic registers, coding contexts, positions and neighbor syntax at selected H.264 slice boundaries to permit entropy parsing restarts. Verify syntax identity before parallel reconstruction and charge sidecar preparation.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse.
definition.minimum_probe: One short owned source and a few target requests under equal memory budgets, with an independent full-decode/reference result.
definition.initial_screen: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse. One short owned source and a few target requests under equal memory budgets, with an independent full-decode/reference result.
definition.primary_metric: Time to the requested exact or explicitly approximate preview, total prerequisite work and retained state.
definition.scope_contract: Correct source/time/target and agreed fidelity. Approximate results cannot populate exact caches or qualify normal playback.
definition.negative_control: Move backward, request a non-RAP dependency, change source or cancel a pending request; stale previews must never become current.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop at E3 preview/index/state infrastructure. Keep proof of a bounded mechanism distinct from a production preview implementation.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Existing preview or decoder access path. Its absence is setup cost, not permission to create a complete preview service.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

define.basis: Existing source-grounded definition imported; acceptance criteria must be reviewed before a new run.

prepare.basis: Residual-only logical ABI and fixture prepared/executed; complete macroblock/slice restart schema remains unimplemented.

screen.basis: Actual restricted CABAC residual-block checkpoint foundation passed: eight 4x4 non-DC luma blocks after coded-block flag restore in a fresh Wasm module using 1604-byte pointer-free records plus source-bound RBSP. Complete binary-symbol traces, coefficients, arithmetic registers, all 1024 contexts and all 120 neighbor bytes match uninterrupted parser state; independent host decoding confirms 30 full pictures unchanged. Corrupt context/neighbor checks and wrong-source imports reject; deliberately omitted neighbor state changes all eight post-state oracles. Five alternating cold component cost pairs, charging initial prefix decode/sidecar generation, serialization, source retention, new module restoration, ten replay sets and cleanup, cost 1.410x baseline (range 1.218–2.196), failing the predeclared <=0.9 threshold. This is one-block residual syntax continuation, not full mid-slice macroblock grammar or reconstructed-picture restart. The full target remains a setup block, not an experimental codec failure.

correctness.basis: Residual component passed complete trace/state and full ordinary-picture checks. Full restarted slice syntax/pictures and lifecycle not yet implemented.

performance.basis: Residual-only workload failed cost threshold; full target correctness and equivalent full-slice cost remain unavailable.

results.basis: Actual component execution, controls, complete preparation cost, limitations and remaining setup captured.

decision.basis: Full target remains setup-blocked; component is correct but fails this bounded cost profile.
